_doc: Provenance ledger for every file under imports/ (lib/objectlint.js rule g; consumed by build-map and preflight's imports-credits check). Exact-path keys cover one file; keys ending in '/' cover a directory subtree (the generated-asset convention). Community assets are Hive Workshop resources fetched 2026-08-07 with the user's authorization — per-author credit is mandatory and repeated in README.md and the in-game -credits command; author terms honored; no bulk mirroring. 'modified' records any local change (script committed under assets/).
